lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Enclave 7. Housing block, allocation office, a bench you ate lunch on for eleven years, and a quarterly budget line older than the Steward.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I filed from that third window. Four days after I asked who Continuity Holdings were, my own access card stopped working.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing here is ruined. Nothing here is even unpleasant. It is simply all decided, and it was decided somewhere you have now been standing.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: So this is where you grew up. It is very clean.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two Wardens at the block entrance are logging faces, and one of them is taking longer over yours than the other.
